title: Uruguayan-Style Roasted Lamb
description: A slow-cooked, dense, roasted lamb dish inspired by Uruguay, perfect for a Mexican-style dinner.
instructions: Season the lamb shoulder with salt and pepper.
In a large Dutch oven, heat 2 tablespoons of oil over medium-high heat.
Sear the lamb shoulder until browned on all sides, about 2-3 minutes per side.
Add the roasted garlic, slow-roasted tomatoes, and carrots to the pot.
Pour in enough beef broth to cover the lamb, about 1 cup.
Cover the pot with a lid and transfer to the preheated oven.
Braise the lamb for 2 1/2 to 3 hours, or until tender and falling apart.
Remove the pot from the oven and brush the lamb with Uruguayan chimichurri.
Let the lamb rest for 10-15 minutes before slicing and serving.
Garnish with chopped parsley and serve with additional chimichurri on the side.
